text: Based on the data from 2021 to 2025, no significant tree-cover loss occurred on this 375-hectare rural property after the 2020 baseline. The analysis used high-resolution satellite tracking (30m pixels) and detected no changes larger than 0.5 hectares. About 12% of the asset was classified as forest in 2020, but no stand-replacing losses were recorded through 2025. The latest observations confirm stability, though small edge changes or areas under 0.5 hectares might not appear in the data.
